__broaden__.i: i — (1) emphatic independent pronoun 'I/me', echoing a verb or conjugated preposition (rof i, arnaf i); (2) spelling of y 'to' before a vowel or l/w (i waret); (3) spelling of y 'his' before some words (i wisc hela 'his hunting-dress') · (4) after ohonawch, probably the 2 pl. echoing pronoun chwi with its ch run into the ending (ohonawch i 'of you') · also echoing a possessive (wy gwreic i yw hi 'she is my wife') · also for ni 'we' after a verb ending in -n, the n of the pronoun absorbed (A pha beth a wnawn i? __broaden__.o: o (o) — (1) 'of, from' preposition; (2) 'if' before a verb (o gwneuthum gam 'if I did wrong') · also 'on, by' (o pedestric 'on foot'), 'out of, from' (o'th garyat ti 'from love of you'), 'of' a kind (pryt … o uorwyn 'the looks of (any) maiden') · also agent after a verbal noun, 'by' (troi o Pwyll y got 'Pwyll turning the bag'); o gosp 'of punishment' · also 'full of' (llawn o'e garyat 'full of love for him'); 'by, through, by means of' (o drycystryw gwreic 'through a woman's treachery'); 'because of, from' before a verbal noun (ymgelu o'e uot 'to hide his being …', the sense approximate); 'in' in respect of (tylluan o'r ieith 'an owl in (the) speech'), the sense approximate

__broaden__.gerdet: kerdet (cerdded) — going, pace; verbal noun/noun, soft-mutated after y 'to' (y gerdet 'to go'), after vn 'same' (vn gerdet; why is not clear, kerdet being usually masculine), and in amgen urys gerdet 'other haste of pace' (cause unclear) · also soft-mutated after pa 'what' (pa gerdet yssyd arnawch chwi 'what journey is on you?') and after llyna (Llyna gerdet 'there is the journey') · also soft after ar 'on' (ar gerdet 'on the move, walking') · also soft after in 'for us' (reit yw in gerdet 'it is necessary for us to go') · also soft after ywch 'to you' (mi a wnaf ywch gerdet y gyt 'I will make you go together'; verbal noun after the conjugated preposition) · also soft-mutated (c>g) after ryw 'kind of' (ba ryw gerdet 'what kind of gait')
__broaden__.beth: beth — what; interrogative pronoun (beth amgen 'what else?', beth a wnaf 'what shall I do?') · also beth ← peth 'thing', softened, in the idiom ys … a beth 'it is a … thing' (ys bychan a beth uyd dy gywilyd 'it is a small thing that your shame will be') · also beth ← peth 'thing', soft-mutated after the interrogative pa (pa beth 'what (thing)')
__broaden__.chyn: kyn (cyn) — although, though; spirant-mutated after a (a chyn nyt ymdialwyf 'and though I do not avenge myself') · also the equative particle cyn 'as', spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a chyn ureisket oed a mab chweblwyd 'and as stout as a boy of six') · also 'before' (a chyn penn y pedwyryd mis 'and before the end of the fourth month') · also spirant-mutated (c>ch) after no 'than' (mwy no chyn elei yn y daear 'any more than if it went into the ground'), the sense approximate
__broaden__.mwy: mwy (mwy) — more, greater; comparative of mawr (mwy yw gan Uendigeituran no chenyt ti 'it is greater to Bendigeidfran than to you'); no mutation (fronted predicate); also mwy dwyweith 'twice as big' · also adverbial 'more', before the subject (a mwy Wydyon noc ynteu lawer 'and Gwydion much more than he'; mwy no chyn elei 'more than …')
__broaden__.holl: holl (holl) — all, whole; adjective, precedes its noun causing soft mutation (yr holl gyuoeth 'the whole realm') · also adverbial 'wholly, entirely' before an adjective (yn holl iach 'wholly well')
__broaden__.maes: maes (maes) — field, open ground; noun m. (o'r maes hwnn 'of this field', of those here) · also y maes 'out, outside, away' (odyna y maes 'from there on out'), y 'to' + maes 'field' as an adverbial phrase
__broaden__.ymywn: y mywn (mewn) — in, inside; preposition, the old y + mywn (ymywn ty 'inside a house'); no mutation · also adverb 'in, inside' (a doeth ymywn 'and came in')
__broaden__.allan: allan — out, forth; adverb ('o hynny allan' 'from then on') · also 'outside, outdoors' (ny ellir allan 'one cannot (kill me) outdoors')
__broaden__.brynn: bryn (bryn) — hill; noun m., spelt brynn; first part of the hill-name Brynn Aryen, Bryn Arien; radical after a 'to' · also first part of the hill-name Brynn Kyuergyr (Bryn Cyfergyr) by Afon Cynfael in Ardudwy; radical, and y brynn a elwir Brynn Kyuergyr 'the hill called Bryn Cyfergyr'
__broaden__.was: gwas (gwas) — lad, servant; noun m., soft-mutated in address (Ha was 'ho, lad'; Bid parawt … was 'be ready, lad') and after wrth (wrth was y uarch 'to his groom', literally 'the lad of his horse') · also soft after predicative yn (yn was ieuanc 'as a young lad') · also soft-mutated (g>∅) as the object directly after an imperative (Ellynghwch was 'send a lad')
__broaden__.wrth: wrth (wrth) — to, towards, according to; preposition, base form (dywedut... wrthaw) · also 'at' (wrth y danned 'at the teeth'; wrth yr ascwrn 'at the bone') and 'because of' (wrth hynny 'for that reason') · also 'with, over' (yn ymhalogi wrth y pryf hwnnw 'defiling yourself with that creature'); in ac wrth y llinyn 'and by the cord' the sense is uncertain · also 'while, in the act of' + verbal noun (wrth ulingyaw 'while flaying'); also 'in the matter of, as regards' (guell uyghof i wrth ymoglyt 'better in memory for caution', the sense approximate)
__broaden__.wrthaw: wrth (wrth) + ef — conjugated preposition 'to/at him' (a dywedut ual hynn wrthaw) · also in y wrthaw, e wrthaw 'from him, away from him' · also 'for him, on his account' (a gahat o uedic da yg Gwyned wrthaw 'whatever good physicians could be found in Gwynedd for him'), the sense approximate
__broaden__.bwrw: bwrw (bwrw) — to throw, cast off; verbal noun (bwrw y bratteu 'casting off the rags') · also in idioms: bwrw ehetuan 'to take flight'; bwrw neit 'to make a leap' (bwrw neit allan 'to leap out')
